recognize_zh: 中央嗜中性球胞質布滿深紫色粗大毒性顆粒，右下方胞質邊緣有一小塊淡藍灰色、無顆粒的區域（Döhle body），核分葉且染色質粗糙，是毒性顆粒合併 Döhle body 的清楚例子。
features: Neutrophil with heavy coarse dark purple toxic granulation
Pale blue-gray agranular patch at lower-right cytoplasmic periphery (Döhle body)
Segmented nucleus with coarse clumped chromatin
Surrounding red cells with rouleaux-like stacking and scattered drying artifact
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at oil immersion shows a segmented neutrophil with heavy coarse dark purple toxic granulation and a pale blue-gray agranular patch at the lower-right cytoplasmic periphery, representing a Döhle body. Surrounding red cells show some stacking and drying artifact. Findings are consistent with toxic changes of neutrophils, as seen with severe infection, sepsis, or G-CSF administration.

ddx.vs: Alder-Reilly granules are present in all leukocyte lineages and are not accompanied by Döhle bodies.
Chédiak-Higashi neutrophils contain few giant fused granules rather than numerous coarse toxic granules.
Promyelocytes have azurophilic granules but a round nucleus with fine chromatin, unlike this mature segmented nucleus.
